title: Rewards calculation error will result in 0 rewards for users
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as users will lose on their rewards  **Likelihood:** High, as it will happen almost always  ## Description  The formula to calculate rewards in `getUserStakeReward` is the following:  ```solidity rewardsPerWeight_.accumulated = (rewardsPerWeight_.accumulated +     (unaccountedTime * rewardsPerWeight_.rate) / rewardsPerWeight_.totalWeight).toUint96(); ```  It is the same in `updateRewardsPerWeight`.
